checks.name: Production app started on loopback with an isolated database
Invalid signature rejected without any workflow writes
Raw body byte tampering rejected
Correctly signed wrong-account payload rejected
Correctly signed simulated webhook authenticated over real HTTP
Event normalization preserves source, request ID, timestamp, event type, and camera mapping
Automatic entrance/time matching produces Northline candidate and preserves manager review
Generated event and original audit evidence are labeled as simulation
Duplicate request ID returns success without repeated side effects
Manager selection assigns the existing designated employee Alex
Assigned task notification is visible in Alex's real HTTP state response
Match selection and task assignment have actor-attributed audit entries
Replay after assignment does not recreate a task or notification
Employee acknowledgment, start, and confirmation still work with actual timestamps
Unknown camera activity is retained as unmatched
Ambiguous matches remain unselected and require manager review
Concurrent HTTP retries are idempotent
Simulated lifecycle notification cannot change the real-camera fixture's online status
UI state separates simulated events, omits raw payloads/keys, and records no fake Ring API success
Unrelated existing delivery and employee records remain unchanged
